SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The section exists but prints under half of the record it claims to carry. IL.memo.json tracks[il-seal-3yr].selfHelpStopConditions enumerates 8 conditions. The delivered guide's single stop sentence carries 3 verbatim in substance (objection by the State's Attorney / ISP / arresting agency / chief legal officer; the court sets a contested hearing; immigration consequences), paraphrases a 4th loosely as 'the printed eligibility facts do not match' (record: 'The disposition on the transcript is ambiguous or contested'), and omits 4 outright: (1) 'A case appears on the transcript that the participant does not recognize, which may indicate identity theft.'; (2) 'The participant has federal or out-of-state records, which an Illinois court cannot reach.'; (3) 'A motion to vacate, modify or reconsider is filed under 5.2(d)(12).'; (4) 'The petition is denied.' This is the same failure mode FIX13 repaired on packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling, on a second enumerated record list the repair did not reach.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: The FIX13 repair holds: all 10 packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling lines are present in participant-instructions.md byte-exact, including the smart-quote and em-dash lines, verified by exact substring match against the registry -- so the petitioner is now told to sign and verify the Request, that a wet signature is expected, and the fee and the Rule 298 waiver. Four separate defects remain in the operative guidance the builder wrote around those lines. (a) The guide directs the required expunge-versus-seal election to 'the Case List's per-case election column, which is where the record places it -- not on the Request'. That column does not exist: this lane enumerated all 78 AcroForm fields on the blank ATJ 2902.1 Case List (1 dropdown, 76 text fields, 1 checkbox; 70 of the text fields are the unlabelled arrest/case cells of a 5x14 grid) and there is no election field of any kind. Worse, the sentence steers the petitioner AWAY from where this packet actually made the election -- Request Section 12 and the Section 13 table, and the Order's section 2. The root is the record: registry packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling line 6 and IL.memo.json manualCompletionItems both say 'Case List, per-case election column', and the official form has no such column. A lane cannot resolve that by editing. (b) The 'Every item this packet leaves for you' list, headed 'Complete every applicable case, outcome, financial, and participant item listed below. Do not sign until the packet is complete.', opens by commanding eleven Case List cells that are not owed -- 'Complete arrest60 on EXP-AD Case List page 1' through arrest70 -- by raw internal field identifiers that appear nowhere on the printed form. See REPEATING_ROWS for the classifier bug that produces them. (c) The same list, presented as complete, omits every checkbox election on the fee-waiver form the packet ships: all 53 FW-CIV-APPLICATION checkbox widgets including '5 - Checkboxes' (the waiver-type election on page 1) and '111 - Checkboxes' on the signature page, plus Request Section 20. (d) It directs 69 completions onto a document it deliberately delivers flattened and un-fillable (AcroForm absent, 0 form fields in both fixtures) without ever telling the participant to print it; only the signature paragraph says 'in ink'.

The Case List's own 70-cell repeating grid is not. production-field-map.json splits one repeating group at an arbitrary boundary: arrest2 through arrest59 (58 cells) are classified 'Optional participant-authored additional-record slot; the platform does not invent it. That conflict is counsel's to resolve; this lane will not edit either record, and 'Treat every figure as county-specific' is a mitigation the registry wrote, not a resolution.

findings.evidence: production-field-map.json: 58 Case List cells (arrest2-arrest59) refused as optional-and-blank; 11 cells (arrest60-arrest70) refused as 'supply it before filing'. Those 11 are 11 of the 69 entries in the guide's completion list, printed as 'Complete arrest60 on EXP-AD Case List page 1' etc. The cells are geometrically and legally identical to the 58 above them, and the fixture carries one case.

Request Section 20 clears 20 ILCS 2630/5.2(c)(3)(C), which is in this route's own registry authority list and in its exclusions. Zero added ink at the '20 - ...' widget /Rect [72,260,12,12] on delivered page 5 (that page carries 43 added pixels in total, all of them the Section 19 limb). The field map classifies it as the generic 'A participant election or financial fact not determined by this packet route', which is the class the guide's completion list does not draw from, so the petitioner is never told it exists. No registration-status fact is collected anywhere.

IL.memo.json selfHelpStopConditions has 8 entries; the guide's stop sentence carries 3 in substance plus 1 loose paraphrase and omits 4, including the identity-theft signal and the federal / out-of-state records limb.

pdf-lib flatten() removed the widget objects and the /AcroForm entry (0 form fields in both fixtures, AcroForm ABSENT) but did not prune their references from each page's /Annots array. Of 167 annotation references across the 13 pages, only 21 resolve -- all /Link, the official forms' own ilcourts.info links -- and 146 point at objects that no longer exist. That is why poppler emits 'Invalid XRef entry 8/9/10 ...' and reconstructs the xref on every read of these fixtures. Appearance is unaffected: Chromium at 307 dpi centrally and poppler at 150 dpi here render the same pages, so this is not a visualDefect. It is shared Illinois tooling, not specific to this family, and belongs to the captain to route once.

IL.memo.json tracks[il-seal-3yr].unresolvedQuestions[0], impact 'release_blocker', affectedElement 'eligibility_branch': whether the 5.2(a)(3) exclusion list is exhaustive for petition sealing, such that homicide, Class X felonies and crimes of violence are sealable by petition after three years subject to court discretion -- 'The enrolled text reads that way. The internal PDF says otherwise. Unresolved, and gating.' This is the eligibility scope of the very branch this family sells. Separately, the delivered guide prints none of the registry's 8 exclusions, so a petitioner is never told which convictions cannot be sealed at all. Both are counsel's, not a lane's.
